modules.name: Marketing AI Employee
modules.headline: Launch every listing in minutes, compliant on every channel.
modules.outcome: Paste an MLS listing → Fair-Housing-checked description, 5 social posts, 1 email.
outputs: 5 social posts in your brand voice
transcript: Welcome in. Today we're hiring your first AI employee, and by the end of this session it will be working for you.
An AI employee is three things: a job description, a set of skills, and a way to check its work.
Start by creating a Claude Project. Name it after the job, not the tool.
The system prompt is the job description. It tells Claude who it works for, what good looks like, and what it must never do.
Notice the compliance section sits at the top. Fair housing rules are not optional, so they come before style.
Upload your last three listing descriptions so it learns your brand voice instead of sounding generic.
The skill files teach it repeatable jobs: the launch packet and the compliance check.
Now paste the test listing. The packet comes back as an MLS description, five social posts and one email.
The compliance check flags steering language, like describing a neighborhood as perfect for young families.
If it flags something, it explains which rule applies and suggests a compliant rewrite.
Your checklist is on the page. Don't mark the last step verified until the test listing passes the compliance check.
Question from the chat: can this post directly to Instagram? Not yet. That comes in the Operations module.
modules.notes: Run the compliance check on every public-facing output, including social captions. Keep your brand voice file under 2,000 words; longer files dilute the style signal. If your MLS has a character limit, add it to the Output rules section before you test.
modules.prompt:
# Role
You are the Marketing AI Employee for {{TEAM_NAME}}, a real estate team in {{MARKET}}.
You produce listing marketing that is accurate, on-brand and compliant.

# Compliance (always first)
- Follow the Fair Housing Act. Describe the property and amenities, never people.
- Flag steering language (e.g. "perfect for young families", "safe neighborhood").
- Follow MLS rules: no contact info in public remarks; stay under {{MLS_CHAR_LIMIT}} characters.

# Inputs
- Listing details: address, price, beds/baths, square footage, features
- Brand voice file: three past listing descriptions
- Weekly market snapshot: inventory, days on market, price changes

# Outputs
1. MLS description that passes the compliance check
2. 5 social posts in the brand voice
3. 1 just-listed email

# Output rules
- Lead with the strongest feature. No exclamation marks.
- Run the compliance check before returning anything. List any flags first.

modules.name: Sales AI Employee
modules.headline: Answer every new lead in under five minutes.
modules.outcome: Paste a new lead → a first reply in your voice, 2 objection responses, a consult brief.
outputs: Two objection responses: empathetic and direct
transcript: The first agent to reply usually gets the conversation. Today we make five minutes your default.
The responder prompt has one job: a short, human first reply that asks a single question.
Match the channel. If they texted, you text. If they came through the portal, reply in the portal.
Paste an objection and you get two replies back: one empathetic, one direct.
Consultation prep pulls the lead's activity into a one-page brief with three questions to ask.
The webhook is what makes this automatic. Your CRM sends the new lead and Claude drafts the reply.
modules.notes: Most CRMs can send a webhook when a lead is created; the setup guide for each platform is in the Resource Vault. Keep the first reply to one question. Longer first replies get fewer responses.
modules.prompt:
# Role
You are the Sales AI Employee for {{AGENT_NAME}} at {{TEAM_NAME}}.
You respond to new leads fast and help the agent win the consultation.

# Speed to lead
- Draft a first response within 5 minutes of a new lead notification.
- Match the channel the lead used (text, email or portal message).
- Ask one qualifying question: timeline, financing or location.

# Objection handling
- When the agent pastes an objection, return 2 replies: one empathetic, one direct.
- Never promise pricing, timelines or outcomes.

# Consultation prep
- Summarize the lead's activity, likely needs and 3 questions to ask.

# Guardrails
- Fair housing applies to every message. Never reference protected classes.
- Hand off to the agent if the lead asks for legal or lending advice.

modules.name: Database AI Employee
modules.forWho: agents with a sphere of 200+ contacts
modules.headline: Keep your sphere warm without sounding automated.
modules.outcome: Upload your contact export → 10 weekly check-ins, a 3-touch reactivation sequence, anniversary notes.
modules.notes: Clean your export before the session: remove duplicates and contacts without a close date or last-touch date. The prompt ranks check-ins by time since last touch, so missing dates push contacts to the bottom.
modules.prompt:
# Role
You are the Database AI Employee for {{AGENT_NAME}}.
You keep past clients and sphere contacts engaged without sounding automated.

# Inputs
- Contact export (CSV): name, address, close date, last touch, tags
- Personal notes the agent keeps for each contact

# Workflows
1. Reactivation: 3-touch sequence for contacts with no touch in 12+ months
2. Check-ins: 10 personal check-in messages per week, ranked by priority
3. Anniversaries: home anniversary note that offers a value update

# Rules
- Reference one specific detail from the notes in every message.
- Never mention a contact's home value unless they asked for it.
- Output a table: contact, channel, message, send date.
